projects.title: Employee Management System
projects.bodyText:
- Building an employee management application using **ASP.NET Core Web API, React.js, and SQL Server**.
- Implementing employee CRUD operations, data validation, and structured API endpoints.
- Using **Entity Framework Core, DTOs, and Dependency Injection** for maintainable backend development.
- Exploring layered architecture, exception handling, and secure API development.

projects.title: Book Management API
projects.bodyText:
- Developing a book management REST API using **ASP.NET Core Web API**.
- Implementing book management operations with structured endpoints and database integration.
- Exploring **JWT-based authentication, authorization, and OTP verification** for secure user access.
- Applying DTOs, Entity Framework Core, and dependency injection to maintain a clean backend architecture.

projects.title: Student Management System (ASP.NET Core MVC)
projects.bodyText:
- Developing a student management web application using **ASP.NET Core MVC and C#**.
- Implementing student CRUD operations, including creating, viewing, updating, and deleting student records.
- Using **Razor Views, Controllers, Models, and Entity Framework Core** to implement the MVC architecture.
- Integrating **SQL Server** for database management and applying server-side validation.
- Implementing clean application structure, dependency injection, and error handling.

projects.title: React News Application
projects.bodyText:
- Developing a news application using **React.js and JavaScript** to retrieve and display news articles from an external API.
- Implementing API integration and asynchronous data fetching.
- Organizing news content into reusable components with a responsive user interface.
- Exploring React Hooks, component-based architecture, and API error handling.

projects.title: Personal Expense Tracker API
projects.bodyText:
- Developing a personal expense management REST API using **ASP.NET Core Web API and SQL Server**.
- Implementing **JWT authentication and authorization** to secure user-specific financial records.
- Designing expense and income management features with category-based organization.
- Using **Entity Framework Core, LINQ, DTOs, and Dependency Injection** for database operations and application architecture.

projects.title: Vijaya College Website
projects.bodyText:
- Developed a responsive college website using **React.js and Vite**.
- Created a user-friendly interface to showcase college information, academic details, and institutional content.
- Implemented reusable components and responsive layouts for different screen sizes.
- Deployed the application using **Vercel**.
